items.en: The form develops comes from Old French, and its deeper history is uncertain.
items.cn: develops 一词经由古法语传入，更早的词源尚不确定。

items.en: Desveloper means to unwrap or unfold a covering.
items.cn: 古法语 desveloper 意为解开、展开覆盖之物。

items.en: Developler enters English meaning to unroll or uncover.
items.cn: developler 进入英语，意为展开、揭开。

items.en: Develop gains its modern sense of growing or expanding a thing.
items.cn: develop 获得「增长、展开」的现代含义。

items.en: The prefix re- is attached, giving redevelop, to develop again.
items.cn: 加上前缀 re- 得到 redevelop，意为「再一次开发」。

items.en: Redevelopment settles as a noun meaning the rebuilding of land, buildings, and economies.
items.cn: redevelopment 定形为名词，指土地、建筑与经济的重建。

note.en: Redevelopment is surrounded by the develop family and by renewal words used for cities.
note.cn: redevelopment 四周站着 develop 词族，以及与城市更新相关的「更新」类词。

entries.definition: to develop an area again
the process of growing or building
the act of wrapping or covering; only a spelling similarity, a different word
entries.definitionCN: 包裹；包住；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the process of making a run-down area or economy healthy again
the act of giving new life to something old
the work of returning a building to an earlier condition

normalIntro.en: Redevelopment is develop with re- in front, meaning a second round of building on the same ground.
normalIntro.cn: redevelopment 就是在 develop 前面加上 re-，指在同一块地上进行的第二轮建设。

normal.en: Re- means again, so redevelopment is development done a second time.
normal.cn: re- 表示「再一次」，所以 redevelopment 就是第二次开发。

normal.en: -ment turns the verb redevelop into the name of the process.
normal.cn: -ment 把动词 redevelop 变成表示「过程」的名词。

normal.en: Keep the pair apart: development is the first build, redevelopment is the rebuild.
normal.cn: 这一对要分清：development 是第一次建设，redevelopment 是重建。

normal.en: The verb redevelop sits behind the noun, so a site can be redeveloped.
normal.cn: 名词背后是动词 redevelop，所以说一块地可以被重新开发。

normal.en: Compare regeneration, which stresses new life rather than new buildings.
normal.cn: 对比 regeneration：它强调「焕发新生」，而不一定强调建新楼。

abstract.en: Picture a bulldozer and a crane working the same city block.
abstract.cn: 想象推土机与吊车在同一个街区上先后作业。

abstract.en: Imagine an old warehouse with a drawing board full of arrows pointing to its doors.
abstract.cn: 想象一座旧仓库，面前摆着一块画满箭头指向门窗的展板。

abstract.en: Think of a coal pit that slowly turns into a green business park.
abstract.cn: 想一想一个煤矿坑慢慢变成绿色产业园的画面。

examples.en: Residents were promised a major redevelopment of the old canal side.
examples.cn: 居民们得到了运河旧一带大规模改造的承诺。

examples.en: Many redevelopments create short-term jobs but push rents up.
examples.cn: 许多改造工程带来短期就业，却也推高了房租。

examples.en: The warehouse is under redevelopment after years of neglect.
examples.cn: 这座仓库被闲置多年，如今正在改造。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞地velop门特」——瑞地（好地）再次被开发，就是旧区重建；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语 develop（原为「展开、揭开」）+ 前缀 re-（再）+ 后缀 -ment（名词）→ redevelopment，核心义「在同一地块上再建一次」。

sensesIntro.en: Redevelopment starts with the physical rebuild of a site, widens into an official renewal scheme, and ends with economic revival and new functions for an old place.
sensesIntro.cn: redevelopment 从地块的实体重建出发，扩大为官方主导的更新计划，最后落到经济振兴与为旧地方增添新功能。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bulldozer clears an old block, then cranes raise new buildings on the same ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：推土机清空旧街区，吊车又在原址上竖起新楼。

branches.en: The literal rebuilding of buildings on the same site is the first sense.
branches.cn: 在同一地块上重建建筑，是第一个义项。

branches.en: The official scheme sense grows out of planning before the rebuild.
branches.cn: 官方计划义项来自重建之前的规划环节。

branches.en: Moving from land to livelihoods gives the economic revival sense.
branches.cn: 从土地转向生计，就得到经济振兴的义项。

branches.en: Giving an existing place new features is the softest form of rebuilding.
branches.cn: 为现有地方增添新功能，是重建最温和的形式。

branches.en: A renewal scheme usually brings both policy money and new industry.
branches.cn: 更新计划往往同时带来政策资金与新产业。

intro.en: Redevelopment is built from the prefix re-, the verb develop, and the noun suffix -ment.
intro.cn: redevelopment 由前缀 re-、动词 develop 与名词后缀 -ment 三部分构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin element here is only the prefix re-; the root develop comes from Old French and is of uncertain deeper origin.
latinIntro.cn: 这里能追溯到拉丁语的部分只有前缀 re-；词根 develop 经由古法语而来，更早的来源并不确定。

items.example: The prefix re- adds the sense of doing a thing again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 加了「再做一次」的含义。

items.example: The base verb develop means to build something up.
items.exampleCN: 基础动词 develop 意为把某物建设起来。

items.meaningCN: 过程或结果的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ment names the process.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ment 指称这一过程。

items.example: Development is the noun without the prefix.
items.exampleCN: development 是不带前缀的名词形式。

items.example: Redevelop adds re- to the verb.
items.exampleCN: redevelop 给动词加上 re-。

items.example: The suffix -er marks the person who rebuilds.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 标出进行重建的人。

items.example: A redeveloped street looks quite new.
items.exampleCN: 经过改造的街道看起来相当新。

items.example: The redeveloping zone draws curious visitors.
items.exampleCN: 正在改造的城区吸引好奇的游客。

items.meaning: the act of rebuilding an area
items.example: Redevelopment carries the full set of affixes.
items.exampleCN: redevelopment 集齐了这几组词缀。
